uplink.description: Example 1: both pulse channels + battery (flags=0x0007) -> one channels entry per channel
uplink._note: reference/upstream-examples.json example 1: ch0_pulse_count 4 / ch0_pulse_interval 600 s / ch0_cumulative_pulse_count 68592 and ch1_pulse_count 0 / ch1_pulse_interval 600 s / ch1_cumulative_pulse_count 57038, battery 3.123 V — values taken verbatim from that upstream output, now scoped into channels entries labelled channel0/channel1 instead of the retired pulseCount2 / pulseInterval2 / pulseTotal2 extras. ch1's pulse count of 0 is a real reading on a connected input, not a sentinel. Satisfies analog-interface (membership sees through top-level channels entries).

uplink.description: Both channels with fully distinct per-channel values (flags=0x0007) -> no cross-talk between entries
uplink._note: Synthetic Decentlab v2 frame, decoded values cross-checked against reference/upstream-codec.js: ch0 count 12 / interval 300 s / cumulative 100000 (words 34464 + 1*65536), ch1 count 5 / interval 900 s / cumulative 42, battery word 3300 -> 3.3 V. Every field differs between the two channels, so the vector pins that each entry carries only its own channel's words.

uplink.description: Channel-1-only frame (flags=0x0006, channel-0 block deselected) -> single entry still labelled channel1
uplink._note: Synthetic Decentlab v2 frame, decoded values cross-checked against reference/upstream-codec.js: the sensor-flags bitmap selects only the channel-1 pulse block (bit1) and battery (bit2), so upstream emits ch1_pulse_count 7 / ch1_pulse_interval 900 s / ch1_cumulative_pulse_count 123456 (words 57920 + 1*65536) and no ch0_* field. Pins the presence policy: the absent channel gets no entry and the surviving entry keeps its wire index — it is NOT renumbered to channel0.

uplink.description: Example 2: battery-only frame (flags=0x0004) carries no pulse block -> error
uplink._note: reference/upstream-examples.json example 2: the sensor-flags bitmap selects only the 1-word battery block, so neither pulse channel is present. Pins the header's policy — the `channels` key is omitted and the frame is rejected rather than emitting an empty channels array.
Decentlab v2 framing rejects a non-v2 version byte.
